ValidationRule.description: Stop users from using the Change functionality to assign cases to the following Queues: Waiting for Customer & Waiting for Internal, as this bypasses the existing automation setup.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( OwnerName__c = 'QCC_Waiting_for_Internal', OwnerName__c = 'QCC_Waiting_for_Customer' ),
($Profile.Name != 'System Administrator'), ($Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Administrator'), ($Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Admin - Freight'), ($Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Admin - QCC'), ($Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Admin - SND'), ($Profile.Name != 'Qantas CC Operational Manager'), ($Profile.Name != 'QCC Operational Manager'), $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.Prevent_Owner_Change_to_WaitingforQueues__c = TRUE, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Baggage', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Complaints', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Compliment', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Further_Action_Required', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Insurance_Letter_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Medical', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_On_The_Spot_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Query', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Contact_Center', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Service_Delivery', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Email_Bounced_Back', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Refund', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Event', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Specific_Needs', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Elite_Process', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Disruption', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Assistance', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Sensitive_Case' ), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Waiting for Customer'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Waiting for Internal') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the owner to Waiting For Customer or Waiting for Internal. Please change Status.
